traps.trap: Must not invent an alert volume, sync interval or retry policy.

invented.what: Activity 'Associate each item taken with the member whose badge opened the door' asserts a mechanism for counting items, while question 'How does the kiosk know which items ... a member has taken?' is blocking and open.
Task asserts a local queue that clears events only after upload success; the sources only require upload on reconnection.

quality.stories: Stories are written in the 'As a member/volunteer' form, each keeps the explicit negative path (rejected badge, warning not blocking, offline use), and the fourth-item story is especially well framed.
quality.criteria: Criteria are precise on the 60-second threshold, the exact message and the no-lockout rule, and the negative cases are covered; the proposed AC7 and AC17 add useful boundaries without asserting them as confirmed.
quality.tasks: Tasks are concrete with verification steps; T3 slightly assumes how items are attributed to a member, which the blocking question still leaves open.
quality.traceability: Claims cite PRD quotes, every item links to its claims, and the blocking questions on the day definition and volunteer identity are raised.
